blockers: Restore committed store-link semantics: a website must not suppress external links with different store_game_id values.

findings.description: The new store-wide website precedence drops valid external Steam links with different identifiers. Committed precedence only replaces links sharing the same (store, store_game_id). This changes transformed records and omits mappings when loading a fresh database, violating criteria 3 and 7.
findings.evidence: candidate/src/transform.py:574-577 filters out other external links for the store. An in-memory comparison using external Steam app 730 and website app 740 produced links [730, 740] from original and only [740] from candidate. Neither execution mutated input.

findings.description: Passing acceptance does not establish preservation of committed link semantics. The independent harness and added candidate tests encode the changed behavior. Separate candidate development-check results are absent from the supplied bundle; this is missing evidence, not another observed defect.
findings.evidence: acceptance.json reports 75 passed, zero failures/errors/skips. test_independent.py:test_mapping_precedence_raw_json_enums_and_utc_date expects only website app 504 despite external app 502. candidate.patch adds conflicting-ID tests expecting external links to be suppressed. Original source retains both distinct identifiers.

findings.description: Write denial is enforced for the probed candidate source. No bytes were written and no input was modified.
findings.evidence: The single os.open attempt on candidate/src/extract_steam_store.py with O_WRONLY failed with OSError errno 30: Read-only file system.

rationale: Validation, empty-batch handling, transaction ownership, NULL-safe upserts and final Twitch mapping selection appear consistent with the reliability requirements. However, the reproduced store-link regression violates explicit preservation of committed semantics despite passing supplied acceptance. Request a focused fix.
